interface.signature: def isCircle(N: int, A: List[str]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of strings N must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 20 for s in A)
preconditions.description: Each string in the array A must have a length between 1 and 20.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) and s.islower() for s in A)
preconditions.description: Each element in the array A must be a lowercase string.

postconditions.description: The function must return either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if all(A[i][-1] == A[(i + 1) % N][0] for i in range(N)) else return_value == 0
postconditions.description: The function must return 1 if the strings can be chained to form a circle, otherwise 0.
